display_grayscale_image: display a grayscale depth sensor image using OpenCV by repeating channels to BGR
display_rgb_image: display an RGB image using OpenCV by converting color channels to BGR format
create_display_grayscale_cli: create a python cli that loads a numpy array and displays it as a grayscale depth sensor image
create_display_rgb_cli: create a python cli that loads an image file and displays it as an RGB image with OpenCV
refactor_display_functions: refactor the display_grayscale and display_rgb functions to accept a window title parameter
